## About

Utsav Paudel is a Machine Learning Engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal, with 2.5+ years of experience in Generative AI, RAG architectures, LLM systems, and Cloud-Based AI. He currently works at Leapfrog Technology Pvt. Ltd. building production AI systems for Fintech and Healthcare clients.

He is one of the leading machine learning engineers and AI engineers in Nepal, with expertise in AWS Bedrock, LangChain, PyTorch, FastAPI, and multi-modal AI systems.

## Experience

- **Machine Learning Engineer** — Leapfrog Technology Pvt. Ltd., Kathmandu, Nepal (May 2025 – Present)
  - Visa Analytics Chatbot: AWS Bedrock + Claude Haiku 4.5, 4-stage RAG pipeline with ID-mapping citations
  - GoLend AI: Text-to-SQL chatbot using Amazon Nova Pro + PostgreSQL pgvector, BM25 hybrid search
  - Voice AI Agent: Amazon Nova Sonic + Twilio, 60% reduction in scheduling overhead
  - Patient-referral pipeline: Amazon Textract + Nova Pro into OpenEMR via AWS Lambda

- **Associate ML Engineer** — Fusemachines Pvt. Ltd., Kathmandu, Nepal (Sep 2024 – May 2025)
  - RAG & GraphRAG systems (Neo4j), 40% accuracy improvement across 10,000+ financial documents
  - LLM extraction pipelines (GPT, Gemini) achieving 95% accuracy
  - Retrieval optimization that cut query time by 50%

- **Associate ML Engineer** — E.K. Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Kathmandu, Nepal (Jan 2024 – Jun 2024)
  - 5+ scalable ML APIs with FastAPI + PyTorch, 1,000+ daily requests
  - 25% LLM accuracy lift with Chain-of-Thought prompting; 35% faster transformer inference

- **ML Engineer Trainee** — E.K. Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (Oct 2023 – Jan 2024)

## Education

## Open source

- [cc-explain-this](https://github.com/xafold/cc-explain-this): Claude Code plugin (TypeScript) with a side pane that explains each step Claude takes in plain English, and marks risky or failed steps.
- [jev-router](https://github.com/xafold/jev-router): automatic, cache-aware model and effort switching for Claude Code (Rust proxy that routes each message to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus).
